description: Build an intelligence pack for one indicator by combining chart-ready series data, derived analytics, and nearest release timing context. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (case-insensitive). Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

indicator.description: Indicator slug for the given currency. Supported: any indicator slug the FXMacroData catalogue lists for the currency, for example inflation, gdp, policy_rate, unemployment.

name: indicator_intel_task
title: Indicator Intelligence Task
